title: John Lear's 1977 lake-level photos of Groom Lake and the film swap

tellings.quote: original photographs from 1977 Groom Lake lake level with a chain going across.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on a story from a man named John Lear about Groom Lake, a dry lake bed in Nevada that is home to the secret military base known as Area 51. According to Corbell, Lear had original photographs from 1977, taken at ground level by the lake, showing a chain stretched across, and the story also involves the film being swapped. If true, the photos would be a rare early look inside a place the government kept closed.
